full_name: Stephen Kantrowitz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Stephen Kantrowitz, associate professor of history at the University of Wisconsin at Madison, studies the intersection of race, gender, and politics in the nineteenth-century United States.
